# @ankhorage/studio

![license: MIT](././paradox/badges/license.svg) ![npm: v0.17.0](././paradox/badges/npm.svg) ![runtime: bun](././paradox/badges/runtime.svg) ![typescript: strict](././paradox/badges/typescript.svg) ![eslint: checked](././paradox/badges/eslint.svg) ![prettier: checked](././paradox/badges/prettier.svg) ![build: checked](././paradox/badges/build.svg) ![tests: checked](././paradox/badges/tests.svg) ![docs: paradox](././paradox/badges/docs.svg)

Standalone Studio authoring package for Ankhorage apps.

## Usage

For local Studio development, run:

```bash
bun dev
```

This starts both the local Studio host and the first-party Studio web app.

## CLI

Manage Studio development and projects through the Ankh CLI.
